title: 真假金丝雀的博弈第11章
content_zh:
第11章 真假对峙

    下午三点整，顾明珠推开了会议室的门。

    她瘦了。颧骨突出来，眼窝凹进去，灰色卫衣松松垮垮地挂在身上。她把背包放在桌上，那个背包还是我送她的，边角磨白了，拉链上挂着一只毛绒小熊。她没看我，先看了一圈会议室——顾西辞的办公室，二十六楼，落地窗外是城中的天际线。

    “你选的地方真好。”她坐下来，“在顾西辞的办公室里审我。”

    “不是审。是谈。”

    “谈什么？谈你怎么把我从顾家赶出去的？”她终于抬眼看我了，眼睛里带着一种我从未见过的东西，不是恨，是更深的东西——是恨自己。

    “我没有把你赶出去。我是自己走出去的。”

    “你走出去的方式太漂亮了。你越漂亮，我就越难看。”她把手放在桌上，指尖抵着桌面，“你知道吗？这三个月，全家上下都在说同一句话——还是温暖有本事，明珠比不上。我妈说的，我爸说的，连李婶烧菜的时候都跟园丁老周说，温小姐在的时候怎样怎样。我的每一个动作，每一个表情，都要被拿来跟你比较。”

    “所以你就给许向平递消息？”

    她的身体僵了一瞬，但很快恢复了。

    “我不知道你在说什么。”

    我把文件夹打开，把许向平的转账记录截图抽出来，推到桌对面。三笔转账，时间、金额、收款账户，每一项都用红笔圈好了。她低头看了一眼，嘴唇抿成一条线，耳朵尖开始泛红。

    “你的账户。许向平转的。第一笔，你回顾家之前一周。第二笔，认亲宴当天。第三笔，上周末。”

    “你查我？”

    “不是查你。是查许向平。”我盯着她的眼睛，“你是他埋在顾家的钉子。你的任务是什么？告诉他我会出席哪些场合？告诉他顾西辞的行程？还是告诉他顾家内部在吵什么？”

    “你闭嘴！”

    “你收了三笔钱。三笔，不是一笔。如果是急需用钱，拿一笔就够了。连续拿三笔，说明你和他的交易不是一次性的。”

    “你不懂。”她的声音忽然变了，不是愤怒，是被人掐住喉咙的那种挤压感，“你根本不懂我在这里过的是什么日子。”

    “那就说给我听。”

    “说什么？说我每天早上醒来都要提醒自己，我是顾家的亲生女儿？说我对着镜子里的自己说你值得这一切？说我每次听到有人拿我和你比较的时候，我都想尖叫——”她忽然停了下来，嘴唇在发抖，“你知不知道，我最恨的不是你。是我自己。我恨我自己为什么会在意你。你是一个冒牌货，但我活不过一个冒牌货。”

    眼泪掉下来了。她用袖子擦，擦了两下就不再擦了，任由眼泪流了满脸。

    “你的行踪是我漏出去的，但不是给许向平。是给林薇。”

    “林薇？”

    “林薇打电话问我你去不去林氏晚宴，我说你去了。她问我你穿的什么颜色，我说不知道。就这些。”

    “你为什么要跟她通电话？”

    “因为她是我唯一还能说话的人！”她几乎是吼出来的，“你走了以后，所有人都对我好，但不是那种好。是那种小心翼翼的、客客气气的、像对待客人一样的好。没有人跟我吵架，没有人跟我说真心话，连我妈——她对我最好的时候，也就是每天问一遍吃了吗睡了吗。只有林薇给我打电话。她知道我是谁。”

    “林薇给你打电话，是许向平让她打的。”

    她的表情僵住了。
content_en:
Chapter 11 Confrontation between true and false

    At three o'clock in the afternoon, Gu Mingzhu opened the door of the conference room.

    She lost weight. The cheekbones are protruding, the eye sockets are sunken, and the gray sweatshirt hangs loosely on his body. She put the backpack on the table. The backpack was the one I gave her. The corners were whitened and there was a stuffed bear hanging from the zipper. She didn't look at me, but looked around the conference room - Gu Xici's office, on the 26th floor, with the city's skyline out of the floor-to-ceiling windows.

    "What a good place you chose." She sat down and "interrogated me in Gu Xici's office."

    "It's not a trial. It's a discussion."

    "What are you talking about? About how you kicked me out of the Gu family?" She finally raised her eyes to look at me, with something I had never seen in her eyes. It wasn't hatred, but something deeper - hatred for herself.

    "I didn't kick you out. I walked out on my own."

    "The way you walk out is so beautiful. The prettier you are, the uglier I look." She put her hands on the table and touched her fingertips to the table. "Did you know? In the past three months, the whole family has been saying the same thing - they are still warm and capable, and Pearl can't compare. My mother said it, my father said it. Even Aunt Li told the gardener Lao Zhou when she was cooking, how it was when Miss Wen was here. Every move and every expression of mine will be compared with you."

    "So you're going to deliver news to Xu Xiangping?"

    Her body froze for a moment, but she quickly recovered.

    "I don't know what you're talking about."

    I opened the folder, took out the screenshot of Xu Xiangping's transfer record, and pushed it across the table. Three transfers, time, amount, and receiving account, each item is circled in red pen. She glanced down, her lips pursed into a thin line, and the tips of her ears began to turn red.

    "Your account. Transferred by Xu Xiangping. The first one was a week before you reviewed your home. The second one was on the day of the wedding. The third one was last weekend."

    "Are you checking me?"

    "I'm not checking you. I'm checking Xu Xiangping." I stared into her eyes, "You are his nail in the Gu family. What is your mission? Tell him what occasions I will attend? Tell him Gu Xici's schedule? Or tell him what's going on inside the Gu family?"

    "Shut up!"

    "You received three payments. Three payments, not one. If you need money urgently, one payment is enough. Taking three payments in a row means that your transaction with him is not a one-time transaction."

    "You don't understand." Her voice suddenly changed. It was not angry, but the squeezing feeling of someone grabbing her throat. "You don't understand what kind of life I live here."

    "Then tell me."

    "What are you talking about? That I wake up every morning and remind myself that I am the biological daughter of the Gu family? That I say to myself in the mirror that you are worth all this? That I want to scream every time I hear someone comparing me to you -" She suddenly stopped, her lips trembling, "Do you know that what I hate most is not you. It's myself. I hate myself for why I care about you. You are a fake, but I can't survive being a fake."

    Tears fell. She wiped it with her sleeve, wiped it twice and then stopped wiping it, letting tears flow down her face.

    "I leaked your whereabouts, but not to Xu Xiangping. It was to Lin Wei."

    "Lin Wei?"

    "Lin Wei called me and asked me if you were going to Lin's dinner, and I said you were. She asked me what color you were wearing, and I said I didn't know. That's all."

    "Why are you talking to her on the phone?"

    "Because she is the only person I can still talk to!" She almost yelled. "After you left, everyone was kind to me, but not that kind. They were cautious, polite, and treated like a guest. No one quarreled with me, no one told me the truth. Even my mother - when she was the best to me, she asked me every day if I had eaten or slept. Only Lin Wei called me. She knows who I am."

    "Lin Wei called you because Xu Xiangping asked her to do so."

    Her expression froze.
title_en: The Game of True and False Canaries Chapter 11
